browser_accept_again: “Browser streaming” is the name of a setting in the host's web console; keep it identical to that setting.
browser_accept_done: Button after accepting the certificate in the other tab.
browser_accept_title: Title of the step that sends the player to the host's address to accept its self-signed certificate.
browser_dial_reaching: Headline while the first answer from a host is awaited.
browser_dial_starting_stream: Headline after the host accepted, before the first picture.
browser_error_title: Title of a connect error with no better heading.
browser_gate_failed_title: Title when the picked profile's desktop can't take a stream.
browser_host_status: status: the HTTP status number the host answered with.
browser_no_answer_title: Title when nothing answered at a typed address.
browser_pair_title_again: Title when a host forgot this device and it must pair again.
browser_skew_title: Title when the host and this page disagree on the protocol.
browser_udp_unreachable: port: the host's UDP port number.
browser_hostcard_rename_a11y: Label of the rename field. {address} is the host's address.
browser_hostcard_rename_hint: Under the rename field. {save_key} and {cancel_key} are key names (Enter, Escape).
browser_hostcard_wake_a11y: Screen-reader label of a host card that wakes the host. {host} is its name.
browser_hostcard_stream_a11y: Screen-reader label of a host card that streams its desktop. {host} is its name.
browser_hostcard_more_a11y: Screen-reader label of a host card's menu button. {host} is its name.
browser_announce_hosts_a11y: Announced on the host list. {count} is how many hosts are known.
browser_announce_connecting_to_a11y: Announced while connecting. {host} is the host's address.
browser_announce_waiting_a11y: Announced while the host's owner must approve. {name} is this device's name.
browser_announce_profiles_a11y: Announced on the profile picker. {host} is the host's name.
browser_announce_link_a11y: Announced when a link asks to connect. {name} is the host's name.
browser_announce_titles_a11y: Announced on the library. {count} is how many titles it shows.
browser_lib_running_now: Under the library's heading. {title}: the game the host runs.
browser_lib_title_count: Under the library's heading. {count}: how many titles the host lists.
browser_lib_search_a11y: Screen-reader label of the title search.
browser_lib_not_connected: Library of a host this page can't reach. {host}: the host's name.
browser_lib_not_connected_this_host: Library of a host this page can't reach and whose name it doesn't know.
browser_lib_load_failed_desktop: {why}: why the library didn't load, one sentence from the stream engine.
browser_ring_menu_a11y: Screen reader name of the in-stream quick actions menu.
browser_ring_fullscreen: Item in the in-stream quick actions menu.
browser_ring_capture_mouse: Item in the quick actions menu and the stream toolbar.
browser_ring_release_mouse: Item in the quick actions menu and the stream toolbar.
browser_ring_stats_on: State of Statistics in the quick actions menu.
browser_ring_stats_off: State of Statistics in the quick actions menu.
browser_ring_mic_off: State of Microphone in the quick actions menu: not sending.
browser_ring_mic_asking: State of Microphone in the quick actions menu: the browser is asking for permission.
browser_ring_mic_blocked: State of Microphone in the quick actions menu.
browser_ring_mic_unsupported: State of Microphone in the quick actions menu.
browser_ring_menu_hint_tv: Foot of the quick actions menu on a TV: how to open it. {remote} and {pad} are key or button chords, untranslated.
browser_ring_menu_hint: Foot of the quick actions menu: how to open it. {keys} is a keyboard chord, {pad} a controller chord.
browser_controls_open_menu_pad: Stream controls row for the controller chord, in the browser's flat list.
browser_controls_release_pad: Stream controls row for the controller escape chord, in the browser's flat list.
browser_resolution_window: Browser option of Resolution: the stream takes the browser window's size.
browser_resize_stream: Browser switch under Resolution while it follows the window.
browser_video_backend: Browser setting label: the graphics API that draws the video (WebGPU or WebGL2).
browser_video_backend_auto: Option of Video plane: pick automatically.
browser_console_mode: Browser row: the controller interface, called console mode here.
browser_console_mode_switch: Button that opens the console mode.
browser_prefs_dialog_hint: Subtitle of the settings dialog opened over a live stream.
browser_player_mouse_mode_capture_hint: Caption while Mouse input is Capture in the browser. keys is the release key, Esc.
browser_player_capture_input: Browser-only switch: off only watches the stream.
browser_prefs_group_playback: Group heading on the Audio tab.
browser_prefs_group_sticks: Group heading on the Controllers tab.
browser_player_deadzone: Browser-only slider; its value reads as a percentage.
browser_about_guide: Link text on the About tab, to the browser client's documentation.
browser_prefs_show_advanced: Button beside the advanced-changed row: shows the hidden settings.
browser_quality_starting: Connection-quality badge on the stream toolbar before the first second is rated.
browser_quality_good: Connection-quality badge on the stream toolbar.
browser_quality_fair: Connection-quality badge: loss that error correction repaired, or a long round trip.
browser_quality_poor: Connection-quality badge: frames lost or a very long round trip.
browser_hud_toolbar_a11y: Screen-reader name of the toolbar over a running stream.
browser_hud_quality_title: Tooltip of the quality badge, which also toggles the statistics.
browser_release_mouse: Toolbar button and quick-menu row while the pointer is captured.
browser_capture_mouse: Toolbar button and quick-menu row while the pointer is free.
browser_hud_settings_a11y: Screen-reader name and tooltip of the toolbar's settings button.
browser_hud_fullscreen_a11y: Screen-reader name and tooltip of the toolbar's fullscreen button.
browser_hud_menu: Toolbar button that opens the quick actions menu.
browser_mouse_captured: Pill over the stream each time the pointer is captured. keys = the release key, drawn as a key cap, e.g. 'Esc'.
browser_sound_suspended: Pill over the stream while the browser holds audio back until a user gesture.
browser_stats_a11y: Screen-reader name of the statistics panel.
browser_overlay_upload: Browser-only stats field: time to hand a frame to the GPU. value = e.g. '1.25 ms'.
browser_overlay_audio: Browser-only stats field. state = the Web Audio context's state token, e.g. 'running', 'suspended': keep it.
browser_overlay_underruns: Browser-only stats field: audio buffer underruns this session. count = a number, formatted by the page.
browser_overlay_carrier_ws: Browser stats line when the stream rides a WebSocket instead of WebTransport.
browser_notice_no_hdr: Notice over the stream when HDR was asked for and the browser cannot show it.
browser_codec_fallback: Notice over the stream after a codec fallback. from, to = codec names, e.g. 'AV1', 'H.264'.
browser_codec_fallback_pinned: Notice after a codec fallback that overrides the player's Video codec choice. from, to = codec names.
browser_exit_menu: Exit hint at stream start on a touch screen. 'Menu' and 'End stream' name the toolbar button and the quick-menu row: use their translations.
